# Mechanism templates

Copy the closest template file and adapt the chemistry to match the paper's figure and legend. Keep atom map numbers consistent across all panels. At each side-chain root, replace unnumbered residue labels with the paper's three-letter codes and residue numbers (e.g., Glu170, Lys91). If a stereocenter disappears in a later panel, prefix its `expected_stereo` entry with the panel name (e.g., `E.plp:211`).

- [beza.json](beza.json): SAM methyl transfer (SN2 at the methyl carbon). Replace the acceptor, residue, and subsequent steps.
- [proton_transfer.json](proton_transfer.json): His general-base proton transfer from water. Replace the root label, acid/base side chain, and protonation states. [Preview](proton_transfer.png)
- [plp_aldimines.json](plp_aldimines.json): Internal Lys aldimine, gem-diamine, proton transfer, external amino-acid aldimine, and localized C-alpha carbanion resonance form, with curved arrows for every step of the aldimine exchange. Replace R, residue labels, protonation, and stereochemistry (written as an L-amino acid) while keeping PLP ring maps 101–106 fixed. [Preview](plp_aldimines.png)
- [acyl_substitution.json](acyl_substitution.json): Four-panel ester hydrolysis by hydroxide (addition, tetrahedral intermediate collapse, and proton transfer to yield carboxylate and alcohol). Replace the acyl group, O nucleophile, and O leaving group while keeping the reactive atom maps. [Preview](acyl_substitution.png)
- [cofactor_fragments.json](cofactor_fragments.json): Mapped SAM/SAH, PLP, NAD+/NADH, ATP, and acetyl-CoA (SCoA) species, with nonreacting remainders abbreviated as stubs. Match the source's protonation and stereochemistry before use, and expand stubs only when the mechanism requires them. [Preview](cofactor_fragments.png)
- [ts_diels_alder.json](ts_diels_alder.json): Butadiene + ethylene, an optional transition state (`ts: true`) with two partial C–C bonds and four 1.5 bonds, and cyclohexene, with three curved arrows on the reactants. Brackets and ‡ are added automatically. [Preview](ts_diels_alder.png)
- [hbond_active_site.json](hbond_active_site.json): Ketone alpha-deprotonation and reprotonation with a Glu64 general base, Gly42 backbone N–H and Lys91 side-chain `hbonds`, and a retained *S* stereocenter checked by `expected_stereo`. Replace the substrate and residue labels to match the paper. [Preview](hbond_active_site.png)
- [radical_homolysis.json](radical_homolysis.json): Chlorine homolysis and recombination, with paired bond-source fishhooks and arrows from unpaired-electron dots into a forming-bond gap. [Preview](radical_homolysis.png)
- [metal_substitution.json](metal_substitution.json): Neutral-ligand exchange at linear silver(I), with plain coordination bonds, retained ammine/aqua H counts, and electron-pair arrows. [Preview](metal_substitution.png)
